emerging_technology: Deployed generative AI text-generation systems built on large language models
intended_application: Draft customer-service replies for human approval
business_need: Reduce repetitive response effort without lowering answer quality
users_stakeholders: Support agents, customers, support manager and privacy officer
adoption_posture: Conservative; requires offline evaluation before customer-facing use
capabilities_constraints: Approved knowledge base; small pilot budget; human approval of every reply; no payment or account-change tools
risk_consequence_context: Incorrect answers and privacy disclosure; reversible drafts; no autonomous sending
management_question: Should management fund a bounded pilot rather than organization-wide rollout?
time_horizon: 8-week pilot; broader significance considered over 10-20 years
